ConfigVariablesTip: Select a variable to change its value. Available templates are shown in the editor, and a custom value can be entered manually.
SetupConfig:
Toggles on these parameters allow standard users to easily customize the config.

The author of this config added the ability to switch operating modes "on the fly" without manually editing the launch string. Switching automatically restarts the component.

For advanced users: To add a similar switch to this widget, you need to configure a conditional variable on the config creation page (see the "Advanced Configs" help section).
UsedSiteListsTip:
Editing these lists will allow you to configure the websites for which blocking should be bypassed.

For example, if you add the website "ya.ru," the blocking will be bypassed for it.
AdvancedSettingsTip:
Links to these sections can help advanced users fine-tune their configs.

Config customization includes automatically selecting component launch settings to access the required website(s), modifying an existing config, and creating a new config from scratch. Config creation and modification are performed using the [Easy&Quick config create utility] utility.

UsedExcludedSiteListsTip:
Editing these lists will allow you to configure exceptions.

For example, if you add the website "ya.ru" to the exceptions, block bypass will not apply to it.
